method: Live web search; original accessible passages read; exclusively original papers or author accounts of their own constructions used as support. No citations to search snippets that were not subsequently opened except publisher abstract explicitly labeled.
scope: Eight core mechanisms plus three short adjacent cases; bounded conceptual atlas, not exhaustive literature review or current research-status census.

sources.title: The pair correlation of zeros of the zeta function
sources.source_kind: original research article, AMS scan on mirror
sources.read_scope: Original pp. 181-186 and 190; theorem, conjecture, RH-independent explicit-formula step and nondiagonal prime correlations
sources.support: Conditional restricted-support theorem; full pair-correlation conjecture and Dyson comparison.
sources.boundary: The opening assumption is RH. Full pair statistics and an unknown spectral operator are not established.

sources.authors: M. V. Berry and J. P. Keating
sources.title: The Riemann Zeros and Eigenvalue Asymptotics
sources.source_kind: authors' original program/derivations in SIAM Review, author-hosted PDF
sources.read_scope: Abstract; original pp. 237-243; equations (1.5), (2.4)-(2.17), especially text after (2.17)
sources.support: Euler-product/orbit dictionary, reciprocal spectral oscillation period versus dynamical period, sign and stability mismatch.
sources.boundary: The authors explicitly call the dynamical identification an analogy/speculation; the raw critical-line prime expansion diverges.

sources.title: On the distribution of spacings between zeros of the zeta function
sources.source_kind: original numerical research, author-hosted preprint of Math. Comp. 48, 273-308
sources.read_scope: Abstract and sections 1-2, PDF pp. 1-12; (2.7) normalized gaps and long-range discussion
sources.support: 100000 initial zeros and 100000 near index 10^12, numerical GUE comparisons and prime-related nonuniversal correlations.
sources.boundary: Historical experiment, not latest numerical extent or a proof of RH/statistical conjectures.

sources.authors: O. Bohigas, M. J. Giannoni and C. Schmit
sources.title: Characterization of Chaotic Quantum Spectra and Universality of Level Fluctuation Laws
sources.read_scope: Publisher abstract and bibliographic metadata only
sources.support: Sinai billiard numerical consistency with GOE.
sources.boundary: Full paper was not retrieved through APS harvest; no claims requiring unseen derivation are made.

sources.authors: S. Müller, S. Heusler, P. Braun, F. Haake and A. Altland
sources.title: Semiclassical Foundation of Universality in Quantum Chaos
sources.read_scope: PDF pp. 1-2; equations (1)-(2), orbit-pair families and explicit small-time limitation
sources.support: Semiclassical mechanism from orbit encounters, symmetry and combinatorics.
sources.boundary: A semiclassical core and small-time expansion are not silently promoted to an all-systems rigorous BGS theorem.

sources.authors: E. Bogomolny, F. Leyvraz and C. Schmit
sources.title: Distribution of Eigenvalues for the Modular Group
sources.read_scope: Sections 1-2, PDF pp. 1-14; (2.5), (2.9), (2.14)-(2.18) and regularization discussion
sources.support: Exact trace/length structure, arithmetic degeneracies, heuristic Poisson statistics and number-theoretic oscillations.
sources.boundary: Formal unsmoothed trace manipulations and Hardy-Littlewood arguments are not counted as a full spectral-statistics theorem.

sources.title: The correlation between multiplicities of closed geodesics on the modular surface
sources.read_scope: Introduction and main Theorem, PDF pp. 1-3; proof-reduction comments in section 3
sources.support: Rigorous Euler-product formula for weighted geodesic multiplicity correlations; explicit separation of heuristic spectral step.
sources.boundary: The theorem concerns geodesic multiplicities, not the full pair-correlation law of Laplace eigenvalues.

sources.title: Hecke theory and equidistribution for the quantization of linear maps of the torus
sources.read_scope: Introduction, equation (1.2), Theorem 1, Remark 1.1 and proof-reduction paragraph
sources.support: Exact Egorov, order modulo 2N degeneracies, Hecke eigenstate equidistribution with precise hypotheses.
sources.boundary: Hecke eigenstates and all eigenstates in arbitrary degenerate eigenspaces are distinct claims.

sources.authors: Pär Kurlberg, Alina Ostafe, Zeev Rudnick and Igor E. Shparlinski
sources.title: On Quantum Ergodicity for Higher Dimensional Cat Maps
sources.source_kind: original published research, CMP 406:174, author-hosted version
sources.read_scope: Abstract, contents and section 1 through higher-dimensional theorem setup; density-one N and matrix-element discussion
sources.support: Modern extension and role of modular periods, prime-power building blocks and tensor products.
sources.boundary: Only claimed under the paper's assumptions along a density-one sequence, not for every N.

sources.title: Hecke algebras, type III factors and phase transitions with spontaneous symmetry breaking in number theory
sources.read_scope: Theorem 5, section 2, Propositions 7-8, Propositions 23-24, Theorem 25, final beta in (0,1] uniqueness paragraph
sources.support: H=log n, zeta Gibbs trace, arithmetic Hecke enrichment, KMS phases, Galois embeddings.
sources.boundary: The independent prime Toeplitz system and the full symmetry-breaking Bost-Connes algebra are explicitly distinguished.

sources.title: Trace formula in noncommutative geometry and the zeros of the Riemann zeta function
sources.read_scope: Introduction; Theorem 5 in section VIII with positive-characteristic hypothesis, subsequent number-field extension remarks; Appendix I Poisson discussion
sources.support: Adelic geometry, absorption/resonances, local and semilocal results, global trace/positivity obligation.
sources.boundary: Theorem 5 is not quoted as an already unconditional global RH proof; its field hypothesis is retained.

sources.title: La conjecture de Weil: I
sources.support: Closed points, Frobenius fixed points, determinant factorization and purity absolute values for smooth projective varieties.
sources.boundary: Finite-field theorem, not the Riemann hypothesis for Spec(Z). OCR powers checked against theorem context; no reproduced scan is claimed inspected.

sources.title: Analogies between Knots and Primes, 3-Manifolds and Number Rings
sources.source_kind: author's exposition of own arithmetic-topology results and constructions
sources.read_scope: Sections 1-2, equations (1.2), (2.1)-(2.2) and associated mod-2 cup-product construction
sources.support: Inertia/Frobenius versus peripheral loops; mod-2 linking and quadratic residues with hypotheses.
sources.boundary: No canonical prime-to-ordinary-knot equivalence, local relations actually differ. This is author-primary for his construction, not an independently reread proof of every cited theorem.

sources.title: Fourier Analysis in Number Fields and Hecke's Zeta-Functions
sources.read_scope: Section 1.2, section 4.2 Poisson/Riemann-Roch discussion, Definition 4.4.1 and Main Theorem 4.4.1, proof start
sources.support: Adelic Fourier/Poisson method gives continuation and functional equation with local factors.
sources.boundary: No positivity or RH conclusion; OCR equations not relied on beyond readable statement and construction.

sources.title: Problems in the Theory of Automorphic Forms
sources.source_kind: original program paper, IAS author archive
sources.read_scope: Section 1 definition of local/global L-functions; sections 7-8 reciprocity questions and unramified parameters
sources.support: Precise local L-factor matching as intended arithmetic/representation bridge.
sources.boundary: Historical questions are not asserted to retain their 1970 status in 2026. No all-Langlands theorem or TFPT correspondence claimed.
